title: Electric Truck Maker Lands Major Fleet Order
summary: A logistics giant commits to two thousand vehicles by 2028.

body.text: The team behind the effort credits a small group of volunteers who worked through the summer.
The announcement follows months of speculation and comes as competition in the sector intensifies.
The hard part was never the technology, it was the coordination.
Officials stressed that the plan will be rolled out gradually to avoid disruption.
Further details are expected at a briefing scheduled for later this month.

author.name: Priya Nair
